dialogues.text: Hey! Here to survey the aftermath of the "battle" last night, hunter?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Figured that since Seamus and Frederica went back and Lohen and Mika are out, nobody'd find me...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Looks like I can't get too complacent! My counter-recon skills are gonna need some work.

choices.text: Bring it on, I'm always ready.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Haha... Well, that's enough rest. Now, time to sort out this lot!

choices.text: Finish your work before practicing those skills, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Turn, left... turn, right!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...Honorary Knight, feel like helping me get them cleaned up?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Oh, just some Knights of Favonius formation drills. These three overdid it last night, so I'm sobering them up.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...And rooting out the worst offender while I'm at it, whose grand prize will be 20 laps. The expeditionary force is allowed to drink liquor, but ground rules stand for when and how much you drink.

response.speaker: Winfried
response.text: I—I only had a little bit!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...Save the excuses, prove it with your feet! Show me you can nail a picture-perfect parade-ground pivot while you're plastered!

dialogues.text: Fair enough. Don't think this lot'll be sobered up anytime soon, so feel free to come back whenever you're free.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: —At ease!
